status: Proposed analytical gold design following local EDA; not yet implemented in 04_build_gold

scope.interval: Hourly export; market products change to quarter-hourly on 2025-10-01

model_decision: Consolidate the consumption and price facts proposed earlier into one hourly market fact. Retain generation by source in a separate fact. This avoids runtime fact-to-fact joins for weighted metrics.

tables.name: gold.dim_time_hour
rules: UTC keys retain autumn repeated local hour
Month-hour grouping uses local time; chronology and episodes use UTC
Market product resolution is 60 before 2025-10-01 and 15 from that local date; data export resolution remains 60 minutes

tables.name: gold.dim_market
tables.rule: Not a universal one-to-one relationship; additional markets require an effective-dated mapping

tables.name: gold.dim_generation_source
tables.grain: One of the 12 observed source categories
rules: Pumped-storage output is storage, not an additional renewable source
Combined wind is a source group calculated from onshore and offshore; do not add a thirteenth physical category
Nuclear category remains present with unavailable generation

tables.name: gold.fact_market_hour
tables.construction: Join consumption, price and generation aggregated to one hour using explicit DE/DE-LU pairing; validate one-to-one UTC coverage before writing

tables.name: gold.fact_generation_hour
tables.grain: Physical hour x market x generation source
tables.construction: Join silver long generation to the unique price mapping once; products are hourly exposure components, not realized revenue
tables.null_policy: For missing source generation, volume and exposure components stay null. Valid observed zero generation produces zero exposure and counts as a matched hour.

relationships: Shared time and market dimensions filter both facts, one-to-many and single direction. Generation source filters only generation fact. No fact-to-fact relationships.
data_types: MWh and EUR/MWh retain fixed precision; hourly price-volume products use sufficient fixed precision such as DECIMAL(38,4). Ratios are measures with explicit zero/coverage guards.

metrics.name: average_price_eur_mwh
metrics.formula: SUM(price * duration_hours) / SUM(duration_hours), matched valid-price intervals
metrics.research_reason: Common benchmark across generation and demand profiles
metrics.aggregation: Recalculate for selected hours; do not average monthly means

metrics.name: load_weighted_price_eur_mwh
metrics.research_reason: Annual exposure is 92.42 versus a market average of 89.32
metrics.validity: Identical valid-price and valid-load mask in numerator and denominator; blank if denominator is zero

metrics.name: load_profile_price_gap_eur_mwh
metrics.research_reason: Shows the price premium associated with the observed load profile

metrics.name: grid_load_mwh
metrics.research_reason: Demand context for renewable output and price

metrics.name: generation_mwh
metrics.research_reason: Volume is the denominator of capture metrics
metrics.validity: Nuclear is all-null in this snapshot; do not replace missing source observations with zero

metrics.name: renewable_share_of_reported_generation
metrics.formula: SUM(generation_mwh for renewable categories) / SUM(generation_mwh across observed categories)
metrics.research_reason: Adds generation mix while distinguishing renewable output from storage discharge
metrics.denominator: Reported generation across all categories, including pumped-storage output; nuclear unavailable
metrics.aggregation: Ratio of sums, not mean of hourly shares; generation-source filter removed only for denominator

metrics.name: wind_solar_load_ratio
metrics.research_reason: The annual high-output-to-load decile has much lower observed prices
metrics.aggregation: Ratio of sums for period measures; retain hourly ratio for scatter and distributions
metrics.validity: Can exceed 1; not renewable share of generation or self-sufficiency

metrics.name: residual_load_mwh
metrics.formula: SUM(residual_load_mwh), where hourly residual = grid load - wind - solar
metrics.research_reason: Strong positive raw and calendar-adjusted association with price
metrics.validity: Negative observations remain valid; not fossil generation or emissions

metrics.name: capture_price_eur_mwh
metrics.research_reason: Solar and wind receive different hourly market-price exposure
metrics.validity: All selected source-hour observations must be available; zero-generation hours remain in benchmark coverage; blank for zero total volume or incomplete coverage

metrics.name: capture_rate
metrics.research_reason: Normalizes source exposure against a common period benchmark
metrics.validity: Blank for non-positive benchmark or incomplete matched source coverage; negative capture price is allowed
metrics.aggregation: Recompute from hourly components; never average monthly or source-specific ratios

metrics.name: negative_price_hours
metrics.validity: Count physical hours once; not repeated generation-source rows; hourly export cannot recover negative quarter-hours

metrics.name: negative_price_hour_share
metrics.research_reason: Makes months with different lengths comparable

metrics.name: negative_price_generation_share
metrics.research_reason: 24.13% of solar generation occurs during negative-price hours
metrics.validity: Same matched valid source-hour coverage; blank for zero denominator or incomplete coverage; not monetary loss

metrics.name: price_p05_p50_p95_eur_mwh
metrics.formula: Exact inclusive percentiles over selected physical-hour prices
metrics.research_reason: Shows distribution beyond means and extreme individual observations
metrics.aggregation: Recompute from hourly values; not additive across periods

metrics.name: daily_price_range_eur_mwh
metrics.formula: For each complete local date: MAX(price) - MIN(price)
metrics.aggregation: Calculate daily values first, then an explicitly labeled mean/median; local days have 23, 24 or 25 physical hours
metrics.validity: Not achievable arbitrage profit or household savings

metrics.name: matched_hours_and_source_coverage
metrics.formula: Count valid matched physical hours; source valid hours / expected selected hours
metrics.research_reason: Prevents missing values or join multiplication from appearing as complete results

publication_checks: Unique business keys and complete UTC coverage
No join multiplication: 8760 market rows and 105120 source rows
Grid load including pumping reconciles with grid load plus pumping
Residual load reconciles with wind and solar within rounding tolerance
Valid source coverage is complete except expected unavailable nuclear observations
Annual headline measures reconcile with EDA before publication
Physical table writes are individually atomic; publishing multiple tables is not one transaction
not_materialized: Monthly averages or capture ratios: derive from hourly components for current dataset size
Correlation matrices, fitted model coefficients and sample-based decile bins: research diagnostics, not gold KPIs
Emissions, curtailment, generator profits, household bills or storage profitability: insufficient inputs
next_research_inputs: Quarter-hourly price and generation for settlement-resolution analysis
Forecast generation/load, fuel and carbon prices, flows and outages for broader price modeling
Tariff contracts and reconciled invoices for the private household extension
